title: a new catch that drops the error and returns a default
how: a catch whose body is one return, one continue or one assignment and does not read the error; passes when its comment says what failed and what happens next (K2's reason test and deny list)

explain.what: A new catch block drops the error and only returns a default, continues or sets a value.
explain.why: The caller cannot tell a real result from a failure. The fault shows up later, far from its cause.
explain.fix: Use the error: log it, rethrow it, or return it. If dropping it is right, write a comment that says what failed and what happens next.

note: 2026-11-18: WARN for one week of its own numbers, then BLOCK - the level change is a record (RM-45), not a timer

selectors.message: catch drops the error and goes on with a default: say in a comment what failed and what happens next, or let it throw
